item.title: Former WVU star Quincy Wilson files to run for WV House of Delegates in District 1
item.description: Quincy Wilson has officially filed to run for the West Virginia House of Delegates in District 1, taking on current incumbent and House Majority Leader Pat McGeehan, who has served in that seat since 2014 . Wilson filed his candidacy paperwork this morning, setting up a high-profile contest in the Northern Panhandle. The news was […]
